breaking_news.headline: When falling housing prices are good news — and when they're not
breaking_news.summary: Denver renters are celebrating falling housing costs. But sometimes cheaper housing is a sign of economic decline. How can you tell the difference?

breaking_news.headline: Is AI 'one big bubble'? Behind the tech sell-off
breaking_news.summary: Investors are selling off AI-related stocks as doubts are starting to surface over whether the massive spending on AI is worth the investment and whether it's "one big bubble."

breaking_news.headline: Congress passes the largest housing affordability bill in decades — and Trump cancels the signing
breaking_news.summary: President Trump canceled a signing ceremony for the bill Wednesday, saying Congress must first pass a strict voter ID bill.

breaking_news.headline: Meta plans to release AI-powered prediction market app, documents show
breaking_news.summary: The company is building an app separate from Facebook and Instagram where people can wager on the outcome of real-world events, using "play money."

breaking_news.headline: World Cup fans are missing games after their resale tickets fall through
breaking_news.summary: The ordeal has left fans forced to either miss out on a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity or scramble to find new tickets, often costing more and for worse seats.

breaking_news.headline: This mindset shift can help you get better at using up your leftovers
breaking_news.summary: Don't let your leftovers go to waste. Cookbook authors share clever storage techniques — like an "Eat Me First" box in your fridge — and cooking tricks to help you make the most of your food scraps.

breaking_news.headline: Red, white and glowing blue: Trump's push for new reactors reaches the finish line
breaking_news.summary: A program initiated by the Trump administration has allowed small companies to rush their testing of several new nuclear reactor designs. Some worry that safety is being compromised.

breaking_news.headline: Supreme Court cements Trump's power over agencies long considered independent
breaking_news.summary: In a 6-3 decision, the Supreme Court struck down a 91-year-old precedent that has prevented presidents from removing members of independent agencies meant to be a check on his power.

breaking_news.headline: South Korea football coach quits as president calls for probe into World Cup loss
breaking_news.summary: South Korea was eliminated after missing out on a spot among the eight best third-placed teams.

breaking_news.headline: Pakistani strikes kill at least 28 civilians in Afghanistan, UN says
breaking_news.summary: Pakistan claims it was targeting militants near its border, but the Taliban government calls it an "atrocity".

breaking_news.headline: US says it has agreed to 'stand down' after exchange of strikes with Iran
breaking_news.summary: A series of strikes over the weekend saw the US and Iran accuse each other of violating the ceasefire agreement.

breaking_news.headline: DR Congo bans mass gatherings in the  capital to prevent spread of Ebola
breaking_news.summary: Opposition politicians accuse the government of using the outbreak to halt a planned protest.

breaking_news.headline: Supreme Court rejects Trump's appeal of E Jean Carroll's sexual abuse case
breaking_news.summary: The decision means the US president will now have to pay her the $5m (£3.6m) in damages she had been awarded.

breaking_news.headline: Sixth person dies after shooting at youth welfare centre in Germany
breaking_news.summary: Four women and a man were shot dead at the scene while a sixth person died in hospital, police say.

breaking_news.headline: Mum rescued from Venezuela rubble with newborn baby tells BBC how he helped her survive
breaking_news.summary: The "miracle" rescue of 18-day-old baby Juan David is a symbol of hope in Venezuela after the devastating earthquakes.

breaking_news.headline: Could you handle a 20-plus hour flight? This airline is banking on it
breaking_news.summary: Some analysts say the first non-stop London to Sydney flight is a major milestone - but would you buy a ticket?

breaking_news.headline: Rogue builder left our roof leaking and spent £30K we gave him in Lanzarote
breaking_news.summary: Christian Williams benefitted to the tune of £160,000 from offending - but had just £1 to pay back.

breaking_news.headline: Inspired by Wimbledon and the World Cup? Here's how to play sport for free
breaking_news.summary: As the world's best players begin play at Wimbledon, how can you get into sport on a budget.

breaking_news.headline: South Korea unveils $880bn chip and AI investment plan
breaking_news.summary: It comes as regional rivals like Taiwan, China and Japan are investing heavily in chip factories and other technology.

breaking_news.headline: Ford rehires human engineers after AI fails to match quality checks
breaking_news.summary: The car-maker found AI quality checks failed to match the skill of veteran technicians.
